Border town destroyed by Alduin in the opening of the game, where the player escapes execution. Bandits move into the ruins afterward and Helgen Keep can be revisited for loot.

The central trade city of Skyrim, built on a hill in the middle of the tundra beneath Dragonsreach. Home of the Companions at Jorrvaskr, the Skyforge and the Gildergreen tree, it is usually the first city visited in the main quest.
Great hall of Jarl Balgruuf overlooking Whiterun, built long ago to hold a dragon. Odahviing is trapped here in the main quest and a Stone of Barenziah lies in the Jarl's quarters.

Ancient stone city of Ysgramor and capital of Eastmarch, now the Stormcloak headquarters under Ulfric. The Palace of the Kings, the Gray Quarter and the docks with the boat to Solstheim are found inside its walls.

Once a great city, most of Winterhold fell into the sea during the Great Collapse. Only a handful of buildings remain beside the bridge that leads to the College of Winterhold.
